_doc: Infrastructure kits of the tile folder (P2-034, tools/bake/infra/build.ts header has every record): per tile the flyover and bridge sides, undersides and piers, the railway tracks and their overhead line masts, the metro decks and the foot over bridges, world metres. The game builds each from its variant kit (game/world/infra/); the tiles hold the plain shapes as colliders only.

BRI-ROB.name: Road over rail and station flyover

FLY-B1.name: Newer precast box girder flyover, single pier

FLY-T1.name: Older T beam flyover, twin or portal piers, orange rail

FOB-B1.name: New Delhi station arched steel FOB

FOB-B3.name: ITO skywalk and modern PWD skywalk

FOB-B4.name: PWD steel road FOB with stairs and lift

MET-RAMP.name: Ramp where the line leaves the tunnel

MET-VB1.name: Phase I elevated viaduct, single box, Y piers

RAIL-BG.name: Broad gauge main line and yard track

TUN-T1.name: Pragati Maidan main tunnel (2022, mural walls, white LED)

UND-U1.name: Flyover-era road underpass and cut, painted concrete, sodium
